name: Marelli
note: Technical partner of Nissan Formula E Team (Season 12, logo on the rear wing of both cars) and of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to magnetimarelli.com, stands under 'Technical partners' with the line 'Data acquisition systems' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026). Marelli Holdings filed for Chapter 11 in the US on 11 June 2025 and says it expects to emerge in 2026 under the ownership of its principal lenders, which its 29 July 2025 release names as Deutsche Bank, Strategic Value Partners, MBK Partners, Fortress Investment Group and Polus Capital Management. Fortress is 68% owned by a consortium led by Mubadala Capital, the asset-management arm of Abu Dhabi's Mubadala sovereign wealth fund (Mubadala Capital press release, 15 May 2024: mubadalacapital.ae/newsroom-articles/fortress-management-and-mubadala-complete-acquisition-of-fortress-investment-group/). As of 4 October 2026 neither marelli.com nor marelliforward.com had announced emergence, so who will own Marelli, and any state-fund stake multiplied along the chain, is unresolved: left unrated.
